Stripped PE32 i386 fixture for kuna_returndepth (tests/stages/kuna-returndepth.xml).

gscookie_pe_i386.cpp is compiled by Visual C++ 2005 SP1 (`cl /O2 /EHsc /c`,
output renamed gscookie_pe_i386_c.obj); gscookie_pe_i386_impl.cpp with
`cl /O2 /EHsc /GS- /GR- /c` (output gscookie_pe_i386_impl.obj); the CRT
pieces the first one references are stubbed in gscookie_pe_i386_crt.s.
`notify` (0x401000) has an EH frame with the /GS cookie pushed in its
prologue, right above the outgoing arguments; it calls the virtual Sink::post
with five pushed arguments (a __thiscall callee that pops them), then
destroys a local Name and checks the cookie.

Build:
  clang --target=i686-pc-windows-msvc -c gscookie_pe_i386_crt.s -o crt.obj
  lld-link /nologo /entry:start /subsystem:console /nodefaultlib /base:0x400000 \
    /fixed /safeseh:no /opt:noref /Brepro /out:gscookie_pe_i386.exe \
    gscookie_pe_i386_c.obj gscookie_pe_i386_impl.obj crt.obj
